name: Enda Shouma
source:
Name: Shoma Enda
Sex: Male
Age: 12 (Past) | 18 (Present)
Birthday: July 12
Profession: 6th Grader (Past) | High School Senior (Present)
Likes: Ferris Wheels, Robots, a Certain Girl From His School, [spoiler]His Dad (Present)[/spoiler]
Dislikes: Old-Fashioned Dirty Jobs, Comedians [spoiler](Past) | Tearer (Present)[/spoiler]
Hobbies: Making Robots
Skills: Mechanics, Decryption

[Past]
Komeji’s son. He despises his poor comedian dad. He likes being alone and doesn't have too many friends. He heads home right away after school to make robots in his room. In the same grade as Mizuki.
[Present]
[spoiler]6 years ago, his father was killed by Tearer. Does he have something to do with the tire tracks at the stadium? He looks the same as he did 6 years ago...[/spoiler]

[From the in-game character descriptions]

[spoiler]Shoma is a subject of genome experiments from Horadori Institute, which has considerably slowed down his aging and growth, appearing as a 12 year old even at 18.[/spoiler]
